title: Updating an object's counter
description: You can follow two method calls that change the same field.

steps.description: Counter's initializer stores start in self.count. You can supply a starting value or use the default zero.
bump increments count and returns its new value. Counter(5) creates c with count equal to 5.

steps.question: What three values will this print call receive?
steps.answer: It receives 6 from the first bump, 7 from the second bump and 7 from the final field access.

steps.description: You see 6 7 7 in the output. Both method calls update the count field on the same object c.
